notes: Only final core.bag was read, no active/reindex/ROS publications or code changes.
ROS log header time is event source time; bag time is recorder receipt. Logs have substantial delayed delivery.
Trajectory header is execution epoch, not publication time. ABORT/Bool/Float64/Twist have no source stamp.
No finish for goal2 must not be equated with permanent navigation failure; bag boundary ends observation.
Progress vector z is execution time scale, not gear.
Full repeated status records were discarded after extracting exact counts, transitions and key windows. Raw closed bag is unchanged.
goal2_status_key_window_rule: Retain statuses within ±0.8s of goal, ABORT or recovery trajectory receipts; all-state counts/transitions retained.

goal2_first_abort.warning: Temporal adjacency does not alone prove the refresh caused the LiDAR input interruption.

dynamic_first_stop.interpretation: Slow safety checked a future original-reference point using wall elapsed phase; fast layer used the paused/scaled native execution phase. This is an observed timing inconsistency, not proof that the physical collision was false.

final_abandon.source_message: [FSM] Give up current target and return to WAIT_TARGET. Please send a new goal.

dynamic_prediction_interface.evidence: All goal2 /dynamic_points messages were streamed; positive/empty transition list has only the initial empty state.
dynamic_prediction_interface.interpretation: Occupancy collision checks saw obstacles, but no dynamic predicted points appeared on this interface. Whether moving-object qualification failed requires tracker/geometry examination.
